jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Your New Team

Do you want to play a key role in developing next-generation medical diagnostic devices that improve the lives of millions of patients? We combine innovative circuit design with the highest quality standards. Together, we shape the future of healthcare—precisely, reliably, and with a forward-looking approach. In our Hardware Development department, you will join a highly motivated, interdisciplinary team of engineers, software specialists, and system architects. We foster an open feedback culture, interact as equals, and support one another through complex technical challenges. From the initial concept to series production, we work hand in hand.

The Opportunity

In the role of Senior Electronics Engineer (m/f/d), you will take charge of the conceptualization and circuit design of analogue and digital assemblies for diagnostic devices in medical applications. Building prototypes and demonstrators, conducting systematic troubleshooting at the assembly and component levels, and performing EMC pre-compliance testing will be part of your daily routine. You will also actively contribute to risk analyses and Design FMEAs, implementing technical safety measures directly into the electronics design.

Additionally, you can look forward to the following exciting tasks:

* Specifications & System Requirements: Define electronics specifications and interface documentation, actively contributing to global system requirements.
* Standards-Compliant Design (IEC 60601): Design circuits in compliance with DIN EN 60601-1 (electrical safety, isolation concepts, MOPP/MOOP, clearance and creepage distances) and DIN EN 60601-1-2 (EMC).
* Approval & CE Compliance: Prepare, execute, and document standards-relevant tests to support external CE certifications in accredited testing laboratories.
* Process & Interface Collaboration: Create technical documentation, oversee the transition of designs into volume production (DFM/DFT), and coordinate closely with adjacent technical disciplines.
* Mentoring: Conduct design reviews and support junior team members with your technical expertise.

Who You Are

For this challenging role, you hold a successfully completed degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Medical Engineering, Mechatronics, Communications Engineering, or a comparable qualification. You bring at least 5–10 years of solid experience in independent hardware development, ideally gained within the regulated medical technology sector. Routine experience with common design tools (e.g., Altium Designer, KiCAD, EAGLE, or OrCAD) and circuit simulation (e.g., SPICE) is second nature to you.

The following attributes complete your profile:

* Circuit Design: Sound knowledge of analogue and digital circuit design—especially low-power design for battery-operated devices. Specific expertise in analogue technology, RF design, or electrical/functional safety is an advantage.
* Measurement & Lab Equipment: Strong practical experience using oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, logic analysers, and electrical safety testing equipment.
* Standards & Regulatory Knowledge: Proficiency with the IEC 60601-1 / 60601-1-2 family of standards, understanding of ISO 14971 (risk management), and familiarity with CE approval processes for medical devices.
* Manufacturing Expertise: Deep insight into EMC-compliant design, Design for Manufacturability/Testability (DFM/DFT), and obsolescence management.
* Language Skills: Business-fluent German and excellent written and spoken English skills.

In order to support the EuroDrone Plateau, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) Digitalization Officer for Programme Management

- Location: Ingolstadt
- Start: 01.11.2026
- Duration: 1 year with possible prolongation

You have a unique chance to participate, learn and grow in the full development cycle of European Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS), aka Eurodrone.

The Eurodrone Program, which is led by Airbus as Prime Contractor in front of the customer (OCCAR: Organisation Conjointe de Coopération en matière d’Armement) and accounts several sub-contractors and suppliers across Europe, is organized in multi-disciplinary Delivery Teams (DTs) ensuring a cross-national, cross-company multi-functional integration and delivery of sub-products. In the specific case of this position, the focus will be primarily on the core business of the MAGiCS Team e.g. the operational components of Eurodrone: Mission, Armament, Ground Control Station, Human Machine Interface and Human Factors Engineering. Efficiency of the development cycle is supported by a plateau located in Ingolstadt (Manching site) where all key actors are cooperating under one roof.

We are seeking a highly motivated working student to join our team of DT MAGiCS as a Digitalization Officer for Programme Management. As the Digitalization Officer for Programme Management, you will be responsible for digitalizing the project management environment using Jira, Confluence and Sharepoint. You will work closely with the project manager and the rest of the project team to ensure that the project is delivered on time, on cost, and on quality.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our daily business.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

- Collaborate with stakeholders and identify potential improvement areas.
- Set up workflows, create and assign tasks, and track progress using Jira.
- Master the challenge of artificial intelligence within Jira.

TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are looking for a Business Systems Architect (m/f/d) to own and evolve the systems, tools, and processes that keep TYTAN running. - Build and maintain the enterprise architecture across business capabilities, processes, data, and applications, building a lean digital thread from Requirements and Engineering through to Production and Service.
